name: TracerHawk
tagline: AI-powered phishing analysis for non-technical staff.
description: Paste suspicious email headers, get a plain-English verdict with a confidence score in 90 seconds, and download a forensic PDF report suitable for incident records, insurance claims, or law enforcement referral. Stateless architecture. Zero data retention.
future: Future capability: mobile detonation — forward a suspicious email from your phone, get an action plan back in minutes. Replaces the hours-long wait for an MSSP analyst or the days-long wait for a help desk ticket.

name: DMARCHawk
tagline: DMARC aggregate report analysis in plain English.
description: Self-serve DMARC aggregate report analyzer that translates technical XML into plain-English domain health intelligence. Identifies authorized senders, flags failures, and surfaces unauthorized parties attempting to use your domain.
future: Powers the Save Play methodology — the disciplined path from p=none to p=reject without breaking your legitimate mail.

name: HawksNest
description: Custom DMARC aggregate ingestion address. Intuitive dashboards. Scheduled cross-provider digests. Agentic abuse reporting that drafts complaints to upstream providers when unauthorized senders are detected — with client approval before any action is taken.
future: The fully realized command center for active domain reputation defense.
